title: Closed Toe EVA Clog Slippers with Side Openings and Textured Sole for Wholesale Shoe Buyers
highlights:
Ventilated clog upper: Forefoot holes and elongated side openings leave open spaces through the moulded EVA upper.

Two strap positions: The pivoting strap can sit across the instep or behind the heel for different ways to wear the clog.

Open rear entry: The foot can slide in from the back while the closed front covers the toes.
